messages:
cs-rep-anna: FinTrust (prod) hitting repeated p99 spikes (~2.4-3s) since 04:12 UTC after the canary rollout. Customer is escalating — SLA at risk. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FT-998. Can eng-sre own triage? :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: deploy finished 2026-03-17T04:06Z — canary -> prod, version v1.23.4, PR #4267 (kernel selector change).

jordan: taking this. I'll start with pool autoscale + routing checks. @maya can you confirm if FinTrust had fallback routing enabled?

maya: quick check — their route config was flipped by the onboarding script last week (fallback:false). Re-enabling now. ETA ~12m.

liam: I'm seeing a pattern in the kernel logs on some A100 hosts: requests are being scheduled with the slower gemm path after the selector change in #4267. That could explain token-level latency increase. Collecting traces now.

jordan: copy. If routing fallback works we can route traffic off the affected pool to dedicated-large while liam works the kernel selector revert.

maya: re-enable command in console:```/routes update fintrust --fallback true --priority high```Applying...

maya: deploy-bot: route change applied for fintrust -> pool:dedicated-large (read:instant). :white_check_mark:

cs-rep-anna: I'll tell FinTrust we enabled fallback and are routing to a larger pool, giving a temporary SLA mitigation. They want an ETA for a permanent fix.

liam: root cause confirmed — PR #4267's kernel preference causes A100s to pick the int16 path in some batch sizes; perf regress for short sequences. I have a revert branch ready (revert-4267) and a fix that refines selector heuristics. Preparing PR #4272.

jordan: what's the estimated time to hotfix and canary?

liam: hotfix branch + CI ~30m. Canary rollout and monitoring ~30-45m. So ~75m for full canary to prod if no regression. If we do emergency rollback of v1.23.4 -> v1.23.3 we can revert quicker but that risks losing other fixes from 4267.

elena: oncall note — for SLA-critical customers prefer routing fallback + hotfix over full rollback unless we see more errors. Keep CS updated every 30m.

jordan: plan and ownership:
- Immediate: maya -> routing/fallback (done) — mitigated traffic to dedicated-large.
- Triage & fix: liam -> kernel selector revert + PR #4272 (ETA 75m).
- Rollout: jordan -> coordinate canary and watch p99 dashboards, hold traffic policy if needed.
- CS comms: cs-rep-anna -> update FinTrust in 10m with mitigation + ETA.

cs-rep-anna: copied. I'll send the FYI now and flag for escalation if we miss the ETA.

jordan: quick checklist for next updates: CPU/GPU p99 by pool, request-level traces for 04:06-04:30, canary metrics (latency + errors), autoscaler events. We'll reconvene in ~30m.

deploy-bot: PR #4272 opened by liam — https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4272 (hotfix: refine kernel selector). CI started.

liam: CI passed on hotfix branch, starting canary rollout in 3m.

maya: monitoring shows p99 trending down in the routed pool. Initial mitigation looks effective.

jordan: launching canary for revert-4267 -> monitor for 15m. If green, promote.

elena: pinging infra-alerts channel to watch for autoscaler churn while routing is active.

cs-rep-anna: FinTrust acknowledged mitigation and asked for ETA window. I'll message them: "We expect a hotfix canary in ~45-75m; routing fallback remains in place until resolved."

jordan: update (final for this thread) — canary looks healthy after 20m; promoting PR #4272 to prod in a staged rollout. Will keep fallback for 1 hour post-promotion then remove if stable. Owners: jordan (rollout), liam (fix), maya (routing). Marking SLA risk mitigated for now; CS notified.

cs-rep-anna: Thanks team — FinTrust relived. I'll close the ticket after one stable hour. :thumbsup:
